I am a 24M senior in college studying computer science, living with my parents. I have a paid data analytics internship for 20 hrs / week, but other than that, I've been feeling lethargic and have zero energy to get off the couch or do much to be productive. The times do I get off the couch, I just gravitate towards lay back down to doomscroll, every day feels the same.

I accepted a cybersecurity analyst job offer at a major company that I'm starting after graduation, told myself I would study to learn the tools, but haven't. I haven't gone to the gym in months. I'm very behind on both house chores and laundry. I'm coasting through classes with B's when I could be doing better. I don't go out. My diet consists of whatever I can easily microwave.

It hasn't always been like this, but my life is kind of a mess and I know I need to change things. How do I get better?
